description: Amendments of v4's state machines that the owner approved (ODR-V41-08, APR-V41-OWNER-2). v4 is frozen at tag indy-init-requirements-v4.0.0 and its files are never edited: requirements-compiler v41 applies each transition over the frozen machines when it compiles state-machine-contracts.json. Check X12 requires each transition and accepted entry to name a state-machine-amendment request and its operator approval, sources that are baseline requirements, and a fit with its machine (known states and events, deterministic guards, Saved entered only by a confirmation); the offline suite checks that the owner's selected option adds exactly these transitions. No state or event is added. Engine.Update (src/Causa.App/Engine.fs, ui) steps MutationSent in the same update that turns the mutation request into HostEffect.Http (IF41-SAVE, IF41-APP); because T-S61 changes nothing, a missing MutationSent changes no outcome, and no test beyond T-S61's state-machine test requires it. Option A's 'records the outstanding request' holds without an effect: the step that sends the mutation (T-S04, T-S14, T-S24, T-S26, T-S54) already records it as Outstanding, and T-S61's guard admits only that request. v4.1.2 (ODR-V412-01, ODR-V412-03): every reconciliation read of SM-SAVE, automatic or not, is sent only while fewer than four were sent in the 60 s before RequestContext.Now (INV-04): T-S31 and T-S32 are replaced and T-S62, T-S63 and T-S65 added for CheckAgain and WentOnline; T-S47 is replaced so it no longer promises a read on return; the automatic reads apply the same window in ReconcileDue (IF41-SAVE). T-S64 states the failed final automatic read (Rehearsal 8 DEV-R8-12). ODR-V412-05: T-S65 schedules the next automatic read at once on return, and T-S58 and T-S59 (replaced) schedule read 1, so no path leaves UnknownOutcome without a scheduled read or Check again. No state or event is added.

transitions.residual: After a known stale head nothing was written, so Unknown commit outcome's fixed words ('may or may not have reached GitHub') overstate the uncertainty. PAT-07 (PERSIST-046-O4) allows only Offline or Unknown commit outcome here, and Offline is untrue while online. Recorded as a residual for the owner, not resolved.
